title: What is Vue.js?

slides.title: Welcome to Vue.js! 🎉
slides.content:
# What is Vue.js?

Vue (pronounced /vjuː/, like **view**) is a **progressive JavaScript framework** for building user interfaces.

- **Progressive**: You can use it in small parts of an existing page or build a full single-page application (SPA).
- **Approachable**: It focuses on the view layer, so it's easy to pick up if you know HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
- **Reactive**: Changes in your data automatically update the UI — no extra code needed!

> 💡 **Think of Vue as a smart assistant**: You tell it what the data should look like, and it handles all the tedious DOM updates for you.

slides.title: Why Vue? 🚀
slides.content:
## Vue stands out because:

- **Gentle learning curve** – Great for beginners, but powerful for pros.
- **High performance** – Virtual DOM and optimized rendering.
- **Rich ecosystem** – Vue Router, Pinia, Vite, and more.
- **Huge community** – Tons of resources, plugins, and support.

**Companies using Vue**: Alibaba, GitLab, Nintendo, BMW, and thousands more.

quizData.question: What does it mean that Vue is 'progressive'?

options.text: It only works with progressive web apps
You can adopt it gradually, from small features to full apps
It requires rewriting your entire project

quizData.explanation: Vue is progressive because you can use it in small increments — start with a simple widget and scale up to a full SPA without friction.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🔍
slides.content:
## Vue Devtools

Install the **Vue Devtools** browser extension. It's like X-ray vision for your Vue apps — you can inspect components, track events, and debug reactivity in real-time.
